Operations.Name: SystemSecurityUpdate
Operations.Description:
Update System Security Service Configuration.

This method is used to change the FIPS, STIG, and local account
policies for TrueNAS Enterprise. These features are not
available in community editions of TrueNAS.

Fields.Name: EnableFips
Fields.Description: When set, enables FIPS mode.

Fields.Name: EnableGposStig
Fields.Description: When set, enables compatibility with the General Purpose Operating System STIG.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the system security configuration.

Fields.Name: MaxPasswordAge
Fields.Description:
The number of days after which a password is considered to be expired. After expiration no login will be possible     for the user. The user should contact the administrator for a password reset. The value of None means that there     is no maximum password age, and password aging is disabled.

NOTE: User passwords will never expire if password aging is disabled.

Fields.Name: MinPasswordAge
Fields.Description: The number of days local users will have to wait before they will be allowed to change password again. One reason     for setting this parameter is to prevent users from bypassing password history restrictions by rapidly changing     their passwords. The value of None means that there is no minimum password age.

Fields.Name: MinPasswordLength
Fields.Description: The minimum length of passwords used for local accounts. The value of None means that there is no minimum     password length.

Fields.Name: PasswordComplexityRuleset
Fields.Description: The password complexity ruleset defines what character types are required for passwords used by local accounts.     The value of None means that there are no password complexity requirements. List items indicate a requirement for     at least one character in the password to be of the specified character set type.

Fields.Name: PasswordHistoryLength
Fields.Description: The number of password generations to keep in history for checks against password reuse for local user accounts.     The value of None means that history checks for password reuse are not performed.
